items.q: I really didn‟t study his music much

ctx.x: Uh, could you talk about his music and/or influence, from Gil?
No, I‟m not, I really didn‟t study his music much. All I know is that he was, before that he was writing for, I think it was a dance band, I forgot … Claude Thornhill.
